text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Tokai Teio in 1st! Tokai Teio has 
made a triumphant comeback!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
—Last year's "Japan Cup." Fending off 
foreign Umamusume hailed as the strongest 
in history, she claimed victory.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
In the upcoming Arima Kinen, everyone 
believed Tokai Teio would take the 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Yet, the result was...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's Teio-san. It's been a while 
since I last watched her workouts...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It's been a whole year since the injury at 
last year's Arima Kinen... I wonder if I 
can really bridge the gap...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Placing 4th in the Arima Kinen fan vote 
seemed less about expecting a victory and 
more about celebrating her comeback, 
didn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...Teio-san...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"My time... that's all, huh. Ahaha, guess 
it won't go like it used to..."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
............ You knew it all along, didn't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I decided I'm coming back. I'm 
going to... run once more――!
The day of the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the 1st and 2nd in the fan 
poll! The presence, or rather the sheer 
aura they give off, is on another level!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, the crowd's attention seems to be 
right in line with the fan voting results.
choice_data_list:
Just hearing the names, I can see why 
you'd get that impression.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide-san in 1st place, and Ticket-san 
in 2nd. Fufu, it makes me happy to see my 
peers getting so much attention.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"And then there's Rice-san, who placed 3rd 
in the fan vote, and last year's Arima 
Kinen champion, Palmer-san."

Rice Shower, a timid Umamusume prone to 
misfortune. Mejiro Palmer, the Mejiro 
family's gal Umamusume. Both had also run 
in the Arima Kinen last year.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It's Tannhauser-san's first time running 
in the Arima Kinen. Oh dear, she's 
completely panicked. And also—

text_block_list.name: Nature's Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Nature! Today's the day—take 1st place 
today!" "Win this no matter what! We're 
rooting for you!!"
choice_data_list: Oh, you've got some devoted fans out there
W-Wow, you've got some passionate fans.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Even though she doesn't 
really self-produce, Nature-san has a lot 
of hardcore fans.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Their passion when cheering is on a whole 
other level...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Wait, that's not quite right.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: âAh, it's Teio-san!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...It's really back...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Welcome back, Teio!" "We were waiting for 
you!!" "Show us that Teio Step!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Nishishi, thanks everyone!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It has an atmosphere so 
characteristic of Teio-san.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
It's been a whole year since her last 
race, right? Even for Teio, that's just 
too long of a layoff...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I'm worried about her mental state, not to 
mention her physical condition. Racing 
instincts aren't something that just comes 
back easily, right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"I'm just happy to see you race again! Who 
cares about the result? Just finishing the 
race deserves a medal in my book!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Against a lineup like this... Even for 
Teio-san, this is going to be far too 
tough."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(...Her run in last year's Japan Cup. From 
that alone, Teio-san is already someone 
worthy of being called the "strongest"...)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: (Even so, depending on today's run—)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(There's also the chance of tarnishing the 
legend of the strongest...)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Teio-san...!

"The favorite, Biwa Hayahide, took a 
favorable position, and the race proceeded 
largely as expected until the third 
corner. However—"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
400 meters left! Biwa Hayahide takes the 
lead! Wait, no—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio is coming from the outside as 
well!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: N-No way...—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It felt so distant... Out of 364 days, 
there wasn't a single day I didn't face 
setbacks.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It was so far, so distant... I couldn't 
reach it at all. There were times I wanted 
to turn my back on the turf entirely, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: —Even so, I came back!

Step by step, with her trademark massive 
stride, Tokai Teio is closing the gap on 
Biwa Hayahide—!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: No, no... You've gotta be kidding me!?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: How could this happen?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "Yet, victory will be mine!! Haaaaaaah!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not a Triple Crown Umamusume. Nor am 
I undefeated. But still!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Will it be Biwa Hayahide, or Tokai Teio!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I am the "Strongest Umamusume" ——Tokai 
Teio!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Teio-saaaaaaaaann!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Goooooooo for it! Tokai Teio!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In 1st place is... Tokai Teio! It's Tokai 
Teio!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio, a miraculous comeback 
victory!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Can you believe what we are witnessing?! 
In his first race in a year since last 
year's Arima Kinen, Tokai Teio has claimed 
victory!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Teio-san is...—!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Nnnrgh! You're... You're...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Such genius! Such brilliance!! Reaching on 
and on...—forever and ever!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: You're the "strongest" of all!!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...! ...I did it...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...I couldn't win...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Te-i-o! Te-i-o! Te-i-o! Te-i-o!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm back!
(WAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Te-i-o! Te-i-o! Te-i-o! Te-i-o!

Endless cheers. The stands kept shaking. A 
storm of joy roared with tearful emotion.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*, *sniffle*... Teio, Teio! I'll... 
never forget today's race as long as I 
live!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
To think a miracle like this could happen, 
man... The Goddess of the Turf sure knows 
how to do things in style!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes. A comeback like this can only be 
called a miracle!
choice_data_list: A miracle... it really is, isn't it...

text_block_list.text:
My head felt fuzzy from the shock of being 
struck by that miracle, so I gave it a 
light shake. The harder I tried to stay 
calm, the darker everything in front of me 
became...
choice_data_list: She truly is the "strongest Uma Musume"
She truly is the "strongest Uma Musume"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
'The strongest'... Yes... That's it. She 
is—
choice_data_list: That's the destination we're aiming for.
That's the goal we're aiming for.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...... Teio-san is the "strongest 
Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Not just raw skill... but armed with drama 
as well, perfection...
choice_data_list: We have to surpass that thrilling moment.
We have to surpass that emotional high.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes... A refreshing youth drama just 
wouldn't work, would it...?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Wait... does a method like that even 
exist!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I got to see today's race...! 
Ticketzo is my favorite, but I couldn't 
help cheering for Teio on the final 
stretch!

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure I'll never forget that moment at 
the finish line either...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
How on earth are we supposed to create a 
drama that moves everyone's hearts like 
this?!

The drama of the "Strongest" that Tokai 
Teio showed us.

It was so dazzling and intense that it 
made one lose sight of even the light they 
sought—
